title: Buying a home in South Florida: where to begin
desc: A practical starting point for international buyers exploring Miami.
body: Start by defining the way you want to live: proximity to work, the waterfront, schools, and everyday amenities. Compare neighborhoods in person where possible.

Before making an offer, discuss financing, ownership costs, insurance and association requirements with qualified local professionals. Ask your advisor to explain the transaction process and the documents you will need.

title: What to look for in a branded residence
desc: Architecture, services and the details worth comparing before a purchase.
body: Look beyond the brand name. Compare the floor plans, building services, developer track record and ongoing ownership costs.
Ask for current availability, deposit terms, completion estimates and the applicable disclosures directly from the project representatives.

title: A considered approach to yacht acquisition
desc: Questions to ask before choosing your next yacht.
body: Consider intended cruising areas, guest capacity, maintenance requirements and the support network before narrowing your selection.
Arrange an independent survey and discuss operating costs, berthing and insurance with qualified specialists.

title: Preparing your property investment brief
desc: Define objectives, time horizon and the information you need.
body: Define your objectives and risk tolerance before comparing opportunities. Consider your holding period, financing and potential operating costs.
Request independent legal, tax and financial advice before committing capital.
